chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked him about oaths, and he said: “It is permissible against every religious adherent according to that by which they administer oaths.”

key_terms.الْأَحْكَامِ: oaths; legal forms of swearing under discussion here
key_terms.دَيِّنٍ: religious adherent; a person belonging to a religion
key_terms.يَسْتَحْلِفُونَ: they administer oaths; the manner in which they make someone swear

ai.seo_question: How are oaths treated for people of different religious communities in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning oaths and how they are recognized among different religious communities. It indicates that an oath may be administered to each religious adherent in accordance with the form they themselves regard as binding.
